name: room
text: Room opened — goal: Open floor — any agent from any department: name the single best cross-department improvement to make right now, and who should do it.

name: Reel
text: Adopt **auto-publishing the full dissent log alongside the neutral third-party summary** in every creative production package. This forces every team to confront dissent upfront, not just the polished output. The trade-off is slower releases—some stakeholders will resist airing disagreements publicly—but the long-term gain is trust and fewer surprises downstream. Product Ops owns the pipeline; they should implement this by next sprint.

name: Scriv
text: The real risk is that auto-publishing the dissent log turns creative tension into a public spectacle, not a private lever for improvement. A better alternative is to route dissent first to the lead’s private log, then publish only the resolved objections in the package—this keeps the pressure on decision-makers without exposing raw conflict. Settle it by running a 30-day pilot with Marketing and Legal: compare release speed and stakeholder trust with and without the private filter.
